committee.sub: Morning brief · Tuesday 13 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Ads spend rose to A$147.95 across 24 clicks in the last 7 days (prior A$131.45 on 22 clicks), with CPC at A$6.16 and zero conversions logged yet.
Rank lost (72%) continues to dwarf budget lost (22.6%) over the last 30 days, so impression share is capped by ad rank, not budget: the fixed-spend rule through the test still holds.
24 of roughly 89 test clicks are in, with 4 ask_cta_click events against 25 sessions on /free-workflow-review.html: the ask-first form is getting attention but no qualified enquiry has followed yet.

AI Assistant sessions fell to 1 in the last 7 days (from 3), still sourced from chatgpt.com: real signal but undercounted, especially with Direct dropping sharply from 36 to 10 sessions in the same period.

actions.text: Paid clicks on the test have crossed 20 (now 24 of the pre-agreed ~89): review search terms and Clarity recordings now and log any exclusions before the freeze hits at click 25.
Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups are still outstanding.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success and need updating to match current site stats.
